front.howto_intro: Letting go is the deliberate integration of what the body learned and never unlearned. Read it slowly. Do not perform it.
howto_steps: Recognise your awareness as the witness of the experience.
Read without taking the words personally. They are mirrors, not judgments.
When emotion rises, do not resist it. Resistance is the block.
Observe the sensation without labelling it.
Turn the senses inward and feel what the body does as the emotion moves.
Stay with it until the charge drops.
Let the new state settle before you stand up.

pairs.install_text: I know that I am clear, honest, direct, heard, unguarded, true, steady, plain, unhurried, open in the throat, saying the true sentence first, able to disagree out loud, done rehearsing the sentence, letting the jaw go, speaking at the speed of thought, true in what I say, true in what I withhold, true in the room, true when it costs me.
